title: 5-Day Ndutu Calving Season & Ngorongoro Crater Safari
description: Experience the magic of Tanzania’s Great Wildebeest Migration during the spectacular calving season in the Ndutu Area. This 5-day safari is specially designed for travelers who want to focus on newborn wildebeest, dramatic predator action, and the incredible landscapes of the Southern Serengeti, combined with the wildlife-rich Ngorongoro Crater.

Spend quality time exploring the Ndutu plains, following migrating wildebeest herds and searching for newborn calves, lions, cheetahs, hyenas, and other wildlife. The safari concludes with an unforgettable game drive in the Ngorongoro Crater, where you will explore the crater floor and search for the Big Five, including the chance to encounter black rhinos.
This carefully designed safari offers an immersive wildlife experience while maximizing your time in the heart of the calving season.
highlights: Experience the spectacular Ndutu calving season.
Follow large herds of migrating wildebeest across the Southern Serengeti.
Search for newborn wildebeest calves on the open plains.
Look for predators including lions, cheetahs and hyenas.
Enjoy full-day wildlife exploration in the Ndutu Area.
Experience the changing landscapes from the Serengeti plains to the Ngorongoro Highlands.
Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for an unforgettable final game drive.
Search for black or white rhinoceros in the crater.
Look for the Big Five, including lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo and rhino.
Enjoy opportunities to see hippos, zebras, wildebeest, flamingos and many other wildlife species.
Travel with a professional safari guide who adapts game drives according to wildlife movements and recent sightings.
includes: Basic first-aid kit and emergency support
excludes: Optional activities (e.g. hot air balloon safari )

itinerary.title: Arrival in arusha – safari briefing
itinerary.text: Upon arrival in Arusha, you will meet our professional driver at the airport and be transferred to your hotel in Arusha. After check-in and some time to relax, you will meet our safari consultant for a detailed safari briefing. You will also meet your professional safari guide, who will brief you about the itinerary, daily activities, wildlife experiences, and what to expect during your safari.

itinerary.title: Arusha – Southern serengeti (ndutu area) – big cats & migration
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart from Arusha and begin your journey toward the Southern Serengeti and the Ndutu Area. Enjoy the scenic landscapes as you travel toward one of the most important areas of the Great Wildebeest Migration. As you approach Ndutu, begin your game drive with a focus on the migrating wildebeest and the predators that follow the herds. During the calving season, the area attracts large numbers of wildebeest, creating excellent opportunities to search for lions, cheetahs, hyenas, and other wildlife. Your professional guide will follow wildlife movements and recent sightings to maximize your game-viewing experience.

itinerary.title: full day in ndutu – wildebeest migration & newborns
itinerary.text: Today is dedicated entirely to exploring the Ndutu Area during the spectacular calving season. Spend the full day following the wildebeest herds across the open plains and searching for newborn calves. This is also an excellent time to observe the relationship between the migrating herds and predators. Your guide will search for lions, cheetahs, hyenas, and other wildlife while giving you time to enjoy photography and observe natural wildlife behavior. The game-drive route will be adapted according to where the herds and wildlife are concentrated, helping you make the most of your full day in the Ndutu Area.

itinerary.title: Half-day game drive in ndutu – ngorongoro highlands
itinerary.text: Enjoy a morning or half-day game drive in the Ndutu Area. This gives you another opportunity to experience the migration, search for newborn wildebeest, and encounter big cats before leaving the Southern Serengeti. After the game drive, begin your journey toward the Ngorongoro Highlands. Enjoy the beautiful changing landscapes as you travel from the open Serengeti plains toward the highlands. Arrive at your accommodation for dinner and overnight, ready for the following day’s Ngorongoro Crater experience.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater – search for rhino & complete the big five
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for an unforgettable final wildlife experience. The early morning crater drive gives you the opportunity to explore the crater floor when wildlife is active. Your guide will focus on searching for a black or white rhinoceros, giving you the opportunity to complete your Big Five experience if you have already encountered lion, leopard, elephant, and buffalo during the safari. You will also have opportunities to see lions, elephants, buffalo, hippos, zebras, wildebeest, flamingos, and many other species. On Day 5, we recommend booking a late-evening flight from 20:00 onwards to allow sufficient time for the Ngorongoro Crater experience and the transfer. Safari ends: Transfer to the airport for your onward flight.

summary: Experience the magic of Tanzania’s Great Wildebeest Migration during the spectacular calving season in the Ndutu Area.
